title: ROUND ( 2.5, 0 ) is 3 and ROUND ( -2.5, 0 ) is -3

source.quote: Ties are broken by rounding half away from zero (also known as commercial rounding).
source.supports: ROUND breaks ties away from zero

source.quote: If num_digits is 0, the number is rounded to the nearest integer.
source.supports: zero digits rounds to an integer; the return value is documented as a decimal number

derivation: 2.5 and -2.5 are exact ties between two integers. Half away from zero gives 3 and -3 (banker's rounding would give 2 and -2). ROUND returns a decimal number, so the results are the doubles 3.0 and -3.0.
